scenario: Matched background idle: two loaded local pages, one edited form, selected second.html, one window, zero hibernated tabs, 100 percent zoom
power: AC; unchanged brightness and power settings
network: Loopback fixtures; no remote-page network workload
attribution: Astra app processes only. Unmapped WebKit helper totals are excluded.
confounds: Both isolated builds run concurrently; unrelated applications remain running
Existing compression and swap; prior profile/cache histories differ
Passive candidate process sampler runs once per minute
